zero_overlap_positives.reconciliation_explanation: Historical 119 count was derived during Phase 2 on an exploratory development subset. In the active 3,000-pair held-out test partition, exactly 33 positive pairs have zero raw whitespace-separated word overlap, and exactly 25 positive pairs have zero overlap after regex word-token normalization (due to 8 pairs sharing only stripped punctuation).

recall_vs_precision_tradeoff.reconciliation_explanation: The dense semantic baseline achieves 0.9893 recall by flagging 79.2% of all test pairs as positive, incurring 1,361 false positives and collapsing precision to 0.4272. In contrast, the proposed budget-constrained framework prunes low-risk pairs early and applies Stage-2 verification, trading marginal recall (0.6501 vs 0.9893) for high precision (0.7157 vs 0.4272) and superior overall correlation (MCC 0.5288 vs 0.3504), while eliminating 36.1% of Stage-2 heavy model calls.

group_conformal_prediction.exchangeability_assumptions: Premise groups are assumed independently sampled from the target domain. Post-selection exchangeability holds conditionally if the identical deterministic selection procedure is applied to both calibration and test cohorts.
group_conformal_prediction.declared_limitations: Finite-sample coverage guarantees apply strictly at the premise-group level. Unconditional pair-level coverage is not mathematically guaranteed under group clustering or post-selection truncation.
